import json,re,pathlib,hashlib
P=pathlib.Path
r=json.loads(P('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/checks.json').read_text('utf-8'))
EN,FR=r['inserted_en'],r['inserted_fr']
cand=P('products/sites/invoice-preflight/index.html').read_bytes()
base=P('products/distribution/related-resources/published-invoice-index.html').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(cand).hexdigest()==r['candidate_index_sha256']
assert cand.decode().replace(EN,'',1).replace(FR,'',1).encode()==base
low=(EN+FR).lower()
terms=['buy now','order now','guaranteed reply','compatible with shopify','customers','demand','visitors','traffic','checkout available']
hits=[t for t in terms if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(t)+r'\b',low)]
r['checks']['no_forbidden_claims']=not hits
r['forbidden_check_note']='Run 1 used substring matching; French demande matched demand (false positive). Run 2 uses word boundaries; hits='+json.dumps(hits)+'. Inserted text says no checkout and replies not guaranteed (negations, read in context).'
r['all_pass']=all(r['checks'].values());r['passed']=sum(r['checks'].values())
P('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1),'utf-8')
print(r['all_pass'],r['passed'],r['total'],hits)
